issuing_body: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) — EV Tax Credits & Battery Manufacturing Grants
source: Created federal plug-in EV tax credit (§30D, $2,500–$7,500); $2.4B for advanced battery and EV manufacturing grants; $500M for DOE vehicle technologies program. Signed as Public Law 111-5.

issuing_body: Advanced Technology Vehicles Manufacturing (ATVM) Loan Program
source: Provides loans to advanced vehicle and component manufacturers to improve fuel economy; Ford, Nissan, Tesla have received loans.

issuing_body: The EV Project — Largest Charging Infrastructure Demonstration
source: $230M project (DOE-funded $114.8M) led by ECOtality deploying ~15,000 chargers across 18 cities; studied charging behavior.

issuing_body: EV Everywhere Grand Challenge
source: Goal: make EVs as affordable and convenient as gasoline vehicles by 2022. Key targets: battery cost reduction (to $125/kWh), charging infrastructure, lightweight materials, power electronics.

issuing_body: CAFE Standards for MY 2017-2025
source: Requires passenger car average fuel economy to reach ~54.5 mpg by 2025 (effectively ~50 mpg), indirectly boosting EV adoption.

issuing_body: DOE Battery and Energy Storage R&D Program
source: Supports next-gen battery R&D (Li-ion improvement, solid-state research) through VTO and ABR.

issuing_body: California ZEV Action Plan
source: Goal: deploy 1.5M ZEVs in California by 2025, including infrastructure build-out and consumer incentives.

issuing_body: DOE EV Charging Infrastructure Programs
source: Grants for public charging deployment including Workplace Charging Challenge.

issuing_body: Federal EV Tax Credit (Section 30D, continued)
source: $2,500–$7,500 federal tax credit for qualified EV purchases; begins phase-out for manufacturers after 200,000 cumulative sales.

issuing_body: CA Advanced Clean Cars II (ACC II) Rule Path
source: First long-term ZEV roadmap proposing increasing ZEV sales share. Updated in 2017.

issuing_body: U.S. Withdrawal from Paris Agreement
source: Announced withdrawal from Paris Climate Accord, affecting clean energy/EV policy direction.

issuing_body: SAFE Vehicles Rule (drafting)
source: Begins freezing/rolling back Obama-era CAFE standards; final 2020 rule reduces target to ~40 mpg.

issuing_body: Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Infrastructure Program
source: H2@Scale program supports R&D for hydrogen and fuel cell vehicle infrastructure.

issuing_body: Federal EV Credit Phase-Out Begins
source: Tesla (mid-2018) and GM (end-2018) reach 200,000 vehicles; federal credit phase-out begins (50% reduction every 6 months).

issuing_body: Multi-State ZEV Task Force (9-state coalition)
source: California, NY, NJ and others sign MOU to collaborate on ZEV deployment targets.

issuing_body: DOE Accelerated EV Charging Infrastructure Deployment
source: R&D and demonstration of fast charging (including 350kW), supporting public fast-charging networks.

issuing_body: SAFE Vehicles Rule Final — One National Program
source: Finalized freezing CAFE targets at ~40 mpg equivalent; revoked California's Clean Air Act waiver for self-set standards (CA portion blocked by courts).

issuing_body: Energy Act of 2020
source: Authorizes DOE clean energy R&D including energy storage, carbon capture, advanced nuclear, renewables. Provides legal framework for EV/battery R&D.

issuing_body: EO 14017: America's Supply Chains
source: Directs 100-day review of critical supply chains including EV batteries, semiconductors, critical minerals. Sets foundation for supply chain policy.

issuing_body: American Jobs Plan (proposal)
source: Proposed $174B for EV market: charging infrastructure, consumer rebates, school bus electrification, battery manufacturing supply chain.

issuing_body: EO 14037: Strengthening American Leadership in Clean Cars
source: Sets 50% ZEV target for new car sales by 2030; directs EPA and DOT to revise GHG standards for 2027-2032.

issuing_body: Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (IIJA)
source: $7.5B for EV charging ($5B NEVI formula, $2.5B competitive grants); $65B for clean energy transmission/grid; electric bus funding. Signed as Public Law 117-58.

issuing_body: DOE 100-Day Supply Chain Assessment: Battery Materials
source: Published in response to EO 14017, identifying EV battery supply chain vulnerabilities (China dominance), recommending domestic processing capacity.

issuing_body: NEVI Formula Program Guidance Published
source: Implements IIJA NEVI program; states can apply for funding to build EV chargers along interstate highways; interoperability standards required.

issuing_body: DOE Announces $3.16B Battery Manufacturing Funding Opportunity (BIL)
source: Under BIL, announced $3.16B for domestic battery materials processing and manufacturing facilities — the largest dedicated battery manufacturing grant under BIL framework.

issuing_body: CHIPS and Science Act of 2022
source: $52.7B for semiconductor manufacturing plus $24B in tax credits. CHIPS for America program (NIST-administered); funds battery and clean energy technology R&D. Public Law 117-167.

issuing_body: Inflation Reduction Act (IRA)
source: Largest clean energy and climate investment ($~370B). Signed as Public Law 117-169 (H.R.5376).

issuing_body: New Clean Vehicle Credit (amended)
source: Post-2023: Removes 200k manufacturer cap; adds income limits ($150k single/$225k HOH/$300k joint); MSRP caps ($55k car/$80k SUV/truck); N. America assembly required; battery component and critical mineral sourcing requirements. Credit: up to $7,500 (split $3,750 critical minerals + $3,750 battery components).

issuing_body: Previously-Owned Clean Vehicle Credit (new)
source: First-time used clean vehicle credit (up to $4,000). Price cap $25,000; income limits $75k single/$150k joint. Terminated Sep 30, 2025 (OBBB).

issuing_body: Qualified Commercial Clean Vehicle Credit (new)
source: Commercial clean vehicles: up to $7,500 (light) or $40,000 (heavy). No manufacturer cap; effective from 2023. Terminated Sep 30, 2025 (OBBB).

issuing_body: Alternative Fuel Vehicle Refueling Property Credit (amended)
source: Residential and commercial charging tax credits: up to $1,000 residential, up to $100,000 commercial. Terminated Jun 30, 2026 (OBBB).

issuing_body: Advanced Manufacturing Production Credit (new)
source: Production tax credit for domestically produced battery cells, components, critical minerals. Battery cells: $35/kWh, modules: $10/kWh (or $45/kWh combined). Effective 2023, phase-down begins 2032.

issuing_body: Clean Hydrogen Production Credit (new)
source: Low-carbon hydrogen production credit (up to $3.00/kg H2), 4 tiers by carbon intensity. Supports hydrogen fuel cell vehicle development.

policy_name: — IRA Critical Mineral & Battery Component Provisions
issuing_body: §30D Battery Component & Critical Mineral Sourcing Requirements
source: Phase-in: Critical minerals sourcing from US/FTA countries from 40% (2023) to 80% (2027); battery components from 50% (2023) to 100% (2029) N. America. FEOC prohibition: battery components from 2024, critical minerals from 2025.

issuing_body: IRS Issues Initial Clean Vehicle Credit Implementation Guidance
source: Published initial guidance for post-2022 clean vehicles, clarifying N. America assembly, income limits, MSRP caps; published list of qualifying vehicles.

issuing_body: Battery Component & Critical Mineral Requirements Take Effect
source: $7,500 credit split: $3,750 (critical minerals) × $3,750 (battery components). No credit if neither requirement met. First qualifying vehicle list released.

issuing_body: NHTSA Proposes CAFE Standards for MY 2027-2032
source: Proposed new passenger car and light truck CAFE standards (MY 2027-2032), targeting ~8% annual fuel efficiency improvement, working in tandem with EPA emissions standards.

issuing_body: IRA FEOC Final Rule (Non-Clean Vehicles Context)
source: Published definition and implementation rules for "Foreign Entity of Concern" — includes entities from/controlled by China, Russia, N. Korea, Iran. Battery component FEOC ban: 2024; critical minerals FEOC ban: 2025.

issuing_body: IRA §30D Critical Mineral Terms Final Rule
source: Finalized critical mineral definitions, qualifying sourcing calculations, and FTA country list (including S. Korea, Australia, etc.). ~50 minerals specified.

issuing_body: EPA Multi-Pollutant Emissions Standards for MY 2027-2032 (Final)
source: Requires ~56% reduction in GHG emissions from new passenger cars by 2032 vs 2026 standards. Most stringent tailpipe standards ever. EPA projected 67% EV market share by 2032.

issuing_body: EPA Heavy-Duty GHG Standards Phase 2
source: Stringent GHG standards for commercial heavy-duty vehicles (MY 2027+), driving electric/hydrogen truck transition.

issuing_body: Treasury/IRS FEOC Final Rule (§30D)
source: Formally published FEOC rules: from 2024, vehicles w/o FEOC battery components eligible for $3,750 component portion. FEOC mineral restriction effective 2025.

issuing_body: DOE Funds Battery & Critical Mineral Supply Chain Projects via IRA
source: Grants ($3.5B+) for domestic lithium processing, cathode/anode material production, battery recycling facilities.

issuing_body: NHTSA Final CAFE Standards for MY 2027-2032
source: Finalized MY 2027-2032 CAFE standards requiring ~2% (cars) / ~4% (light trucks) annual fuel efficiency improvement, reaching ~58 mpg equivalent by 2032.

issuing_body: NEVI State Charger Deployments Accelerate
source: Multiple states deploy NEVI-funded fast-charging stations (~every 50 miles on interstates). First sites operational in OH, NY, PA, others.

issuing_body: EO: Termination of Biden EV Mandate
source: Presidential EO directing all federal agencies to eliminate EV mandates and requirements. EPA directed to reconsider 2024 emissions standards.

issuing_body: EO: Unleashing American Energy
source: Declared national energy emergency; revoked EV priority policies; rescinded multiple environmental EOs; expanded fossil fuel production.

issuing_body: EPA Reconsiders MY2027-2032 Standards & Heavy-Duty GHG Rule
source: Administrator Zeldin announces reconsideration of 2024 LD/MD multi-pollutant and HD GHG standards, claiming prior rules >$700B compliance costs.

issuing_body: EPA Launches Endangerment Finding Repeal Process
source: Initiated administrative process to repeal 2009 GHG Endangerment Finding — the legal foundation for all federal vehicle GHG regulations.

issuing_body: Federal EV Fleet Procurement Targets Canceled
source: Rescinded prior 5-year federal EV fleet procurement goals and preference policies; restores traditional vehicle procurement.

issuing_body: EPA Revokes CA ZEV Advanced Clean Cars Waiver
source: EPA revokes California's Clean Air Act waiver for voluntary ZEV push mechanism, limiting CA's ability to set stricter-than-federal standards. Finalized Nov 2025.

issuing_body: EPA CAFE Preemption Interim Final Rule
source: Published interim final rule prohibiting states from setting fuel economy standards independent of federal CAFE, directly targeting California's ACC and ZEV rules.

issuing_body: One, Big, Beautiful Bill (OBBB) — Major Tax Legislation
source: Signed as Public Law 119-21. Accelerated termination: §30D new EV credit (Sep 30, 2025), §25E used EV credit (Sep 30, 2025), §45W commercial EV credit (Sep 30, 2025), §30C charging credit (Jun 30, 2026).

issuing_body: IRS Issues OBBB Accelerated Termination FAQs
source: Clarifies "acquired" definition for EV credits under accelerated termination: entering binding contract + payment = acquired.

issuing_body: §30D, §25E, §45W Tax Credits Terminated
source: New clean vehicle ($7,500), used clean vehicle ($4,000), and commercial clean vehicle ($7,500-$40,000) credits stop accepting new applications. Previously contracted vehicles still eligible at delivery.

issuing_body: Tariffs Significantly Increased (on Chinese goods)
source: High tariffs imposed on Chinese imports including EV batteries & components, critical minerals. EV import tariffs raised to 100%+.

issuing_body: HJ Resolution: EPA Heavy-Duty NOx Standard Disapproval
source: CRA joint resolution to repeal 2022 EPA Heavy-Duty NOx emission standard.

issuing_body: CRA Resolution: EPA 2024 Light-Duty GHG Standards Disapproval
source: CRA joint resolution to repeal EPA 2024 Multi-Pollutant Standards (MY 2027-2032), signed by President. EPA directed to revert to 2020 SAFE rule levels.

issuing_body: §45X Advanced Manufacturing Credit Amendment Proposal
source: [Needs verification] Proposed legislation under discussion to amend §45X production tax credit (battery components/critical minerals) terms and phase-down timeline.

issuing_body: NEVI Charging Infrastructure Fund Spending Tracker
source: [Status tracking, not a new policy] Status of the $7.5B NEVI federal fund disbursement and state-level charger deployment as of April 2026. Multiple states completed rounds of site awards, but overall spending slower than anticipated.

issuing_body: §30D/§30C Tax Credits Complete Termination
source: Per OBBB (Public Law 119-21), the federal charging infrastructure tax credit (§30C, up to $30,000/location) terminates Jun 30, 2026. This is the final step of OBBB clean energy tax repeal — §30D (new clean vehicle $7,500), §25E (used clean vehicle $4,000), §45W (commercial clean vehicle) had terminated Sep 30, 2025.
